summary.headline: Astrological Houses and the Hyleg
summary.text: Astrological discussion of the four angles, middle houses, and cadent houses, ranking their effects on authority, fortune, health, enemies, substance, and other affairs. Saturn’s debility and placement in the angles explain a man’s limited gain and delayed success; Chapter XI then begins on finding the Hyleg of the native.
